payload.intro: Sandwiches, dearie! Fresh from my tray. Only, one of these never makes it on there.
payload.prompt: Which of these is never on my tray?
payload.explanation: She offers a baguette, a triangle or square sandwich, a chocolate bar, a kebab, a roll or a meat pie. Never a doughnut.

payload.intro: Manta ray on rye, dearie? Took me years before I could cook one without burning it.
payload.prompt: What Cooking level do you need to cook a manta ray?
payload.explanation: Raw manta ray needs 91 Cooking, and only a Cooking cape stops it burning altogether.

payload.intro: Those Fitzharmon boys each hand out gauntlets. One pair keeps my fish from burning to a crisp.
payload.prompt: Which gauntlets from the Fitzharmon brothers make you burn fewer lobsters, swordfish and sharks?
payload.explanation: After Family Crest, Caleb Fitzharmon turns your gauntlets into cooking gauntlets. They also help with monkfish, anglerfish and kyatt.

payload.intro: An anglerfish sandwich fills you up past the brim, dear. But by how much?
payload.prompt: How many hitpoints does an anglerfish heal at 99 Hitpoints?
payload.explanation: At 99 Hitpoints an anglerfish heals 22, and it may take you above your maximum, up to 121.

payload.intro: Four fish for your lunch, dearie, but one of them goes down differently from the rest.
payload.prompt: Which of these foods doesn't belong?
payload.explanation: A cooked karambwan can be eaten in the same tick right after other food. That trick is called combo eating.

payload.intro: Oh dear, you must be tired from all the running around just to avoid me!
payload.prompt: Select the foods that restore run energy when eaten.

payload.intro: My cousin in the Cooking Guild bakes the most wonderful pies. Do you know what each one does for you?
payload.prompt: Match each pie to the skill it temporarily boosts.
payload.explanation: Summer pies boost Agility by 5, admiral pies boost Fishing by 5, wild pies boost Slayer by 5 (and Ranged by 4) and botanical pies boost Herblore by 4.

payload.intro: A good jug of wine goes lovely with a baguette, dearie. You just have to let the grapes sit for a moment!
payload.prompt: How many seconds does a jug of unfermented wine take to ferment after you stop making more?
payload.explanation: Unfermented wine ferments after 20 game ticks (12 seconds) once you stop adding grapes to jugs of water.

payload.intro: Some snacks disappear in one gulp, dearie, while others you have to savour bite by bite!
payload.prompt: Sort these foods by how many bites it takes to finish one.
payload.explanation: Sandwiches and baguettes are eaten in one bite, all pies and pizzas take two halves, and whole cakes take three slices.

payload.intro: Sometimes a mystery box has a baguette in it that's been sitting around far too long. Don't break a tooth, love!
payload.prompt: What is the rare, wieldable weapon version of a baguette called?
payload.explanation: The stale baguette is a rare reward from mystery boxes and the Sandwich Lady or Quiz Master events.

payload.intro: Need a warm cuppa to wash down that triangle sandwich? A proper herbal tea takes three different kinds of leaf.
payload.prompt: Which herb is NOT used to brew a Guthix rest tea?
payload.explanation: A Guthix rest is brewed with a cup of hot water, two guam leaves, one marrentill and one harralander.

payload.intro: Two slices of tropical goodness, dearie! How much health will a whole pineapple pizza give you?
payload.prompt: How many hitpoints does a whole pineapple pizza heal across both halves?
payload.explanation: Each half of a pineapple pizza heals 11 hitpoints, making 22 in total—more than a shark!
